build.beforeDevCommand: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const cp=require('child_process');const candidates=['./frontend','.', './crates/gestura-gui/frontend'];const prefix=candidates.find(d=>fs.existsSync(d+'/package.json'));if(!prefix){console.error('Could not locate frontend package.json. cwd=',process.cwd());process.exit(1);}const npm=process.platform==='win32'?'npm.cmd':'npm';const r=cp.spawnSync(npm,['--prefix',prefix,'run','dev'],{stdio:'inherit'});process.exit(r.status??1);"
build.beforeBuildCommand: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const cp=require('child_process');const candidates=['./frontend','.', './crates/gestura-gui/frontend'];const prefix=candidates.find(d=>fs.existsSync(d+'/package.json'));if(!prefix){console.error('Could not locate frontend package.json. cwd=',process.cwd());process.exit(1);}const npm=process.platform==='win32'?'npm.cmd':'npm';const r=cp.spawnSync(npm,['--prefix',prefix,'run','build'],{stdio:'inherit'});process.exit(r.status??1);"
